name: What should good wainscoting look like when it’s done, and how high should it go?
description: It should look straight, secure, and balanced with the room. Many designs use about the lower third of the wall, but the right height depends on the space.

mainEntity.name: What should good wainscoting look like when it’s done, and how high should it go?

acceptedAnswer.text: Well-installed wainscoting should look straight, feel solid, and create a finished lower wall that matches the room style. If you want a classic look, the lower third of the wall is a common design target, but the exact height should fit the room and ceiling height.
